clinician.trajectory_summary: A 37-year-old Hispanic male presented with symptoms of episodic vertigo, nausea, left-sided tinnitus, and hearing loss. Neurological examination was normal and a provisional diagnosis of Meniere's disease was made. An MRI of the brain was ordered and revealed a 3 mm postinflammatory calcification in the right parietal lobe, consistent with neurocysticercosis, confirming the final diagnosis.
